list: Official PS5 trophy list, frozen at launch week (19 Nov 2026). Names, descriptions, grades and PSN progress targets match the official list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles; the two agree on every name, description and grade. 55 trophies: 1 Platinum, 2 Gold, 6 Silver, 46 Bronze. 28 are hidden until earned. All 55 unlock in single-player; there are no online trophies at launch.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5): https://www.exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies/ — names, descriptions, grades
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi — names, descriptions, grades, PSN progress targets
Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List (checked 19 Nov 2026): https://outputlag.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-list/ — cross-check of grades, Gamerscore, missable warning, launch-week unlock reporting
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap: https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap — platinum time estimate, 100% checklist context
note: Guide text in this file is the author's own writing, built from the official descriptions above. Anything not yet confirmed in the game is labelled unconfirmed. No guide text is copied from any other site.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no separate task: work through the roadmap in this guide — story first, then the side-story finales, then the robbery set, then the long grinds (250 stunts, 50 Challenges, 100% completion) — and it unlocks at the end. Expect roughly 150 to 250 hours, most of it spent on the 100% checklist rather than on anything difficult.
trophies.tip: No online play, no difficulty setting and no mission medals are required. It is a long list, not a hard one.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — the checklist only appears after the story ends, but work done earlier still counts). The checklist is the real endgame: all story missions, 300 stunts, 70 of the 80 Challenges, 200 of the 277 vehicle models discovered, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 illegal operations, and the collectible sets. Track it in the checklist tab and clear one category at a time instead of wandering.
trophies.tip: Cunning Stunts only needs 250 stunts; 100% needs 300. Keep doing stunts past the trophy pop.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and it pops at the end of the mission. Just play the story.
trophies.tip: This is the first trophy most players earn.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete every mission in Chapter 1 and it pops as the chapter closes. Before the chapter ends, do the one thing in the game that can be missed: Lucia's balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude).
trophies.tip: Keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1 until the meditation is done.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Finish Chapter 2 and it pops as the chapter closes. Chapter 2 is where the map really opens up: character switching unlocks after Breakfast Run, and most free-roam trophies become possible from here.
trophies.tip: Use Chapter 2 to buy your first garages and start scanning vehicles with the WAiNK app.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Finish Chapter 3 and it pops as the chapter closes. Do the time-sensitive race against Yago the moment it appears in this chapter (it carries an hourglass icon) — it feeds the Strangers & Freaks strand, and waiting can cost you the strand.
trophies.tip: Save before the Yago race, then race immediately.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Finish Chapter 4 and it pops as the chapter closes. The bank-vault robberies open up near the end of this chapter through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is — do it before the finale so the vault trophies are available.
trophies.tip: Bring your partner to vault jobs: you cannot carry all the bags alone.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy and one of only two Golds. Complete the final story mission and it pops. Before you start it, make an untouched manual save: there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so that save is your safety net for anything you still need from the late game.
trophies.tip: Everything outside the story stays available after the credits, so the finale is not a point of no return for free-roam trophies.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. It also unlocks character switching between Jason and Lucia, which most partner trophies depend on — after this mission, call your partner in before robberies and activities that need two people.
trophies.tip: Switching unlocks right after this mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the story heist mission The Cartel Heist and it pops at the end of the mission. No special preparation is needed — just play the mission through.
trophies.tip: Heist missions cannot be replayed, so enjoy it the first time.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the mission Child's Play and it pops at the end. Just play the story.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the mission Headliners and it pops at the end. Just play the story.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown and it pops at the end. The mission takes place at Vice City International Airport — remember the airport layout, because the Catch Me If You Can trophy sends you back here in free roam.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory and it pops at the end. Just play the story.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's full questline and complete his final mission. Andy's strand is Lucia-only, so play it as Lucia. The side-story finales stay available after the credits, so there is no rush — but finish the strand before chasing Strangers & Freaks, since Andy's missions do not count toward that trophy.
trophies.tip: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands have their own trophies and do not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's full questline and complete his final mission. Like the other side-story finales, it stays available after the credits. Work through his missions whenever they appear on the map and the finale will unlock in time.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's full questline and complete his final mission. Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — it has its own trophy instead. It stays available after the credits.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's full questline and complete his final mission. Randy's strand stays available after the credits, so clear it during the post-story cleanup alongside the other side-story finales.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's full questline and complete his final mission. Tyrone's strand is Jason-only, so play it as Jason, and it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks. It stays available after the credits.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Play Bret Vogel's hunting questline — it is Jason-only — and hunt the unique animal he asks for. Bret sends you after animals through target decks, so follow his briefings one by one. Take clean head or heart shots: a tidy kill keeps the carcass pristine, which is what a hunting questline cares about. The finale stays available after the credits.
trophies.tip: Use a scoped rifle and shoot from cover; spooked animals bolt and waste the trip.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. Not every optional questline counts: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands have their own trophies and do not count here, so do not waste strands on them for this counter. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish to confirm it counted. One strand is time-sensitive: the Chapter 3 race against Yago carries an hourglass icon, so save first and race the moment it appears.
trophies.tip: The counter is your friend — if a strand does not move it, that strand is one of the excluded ones.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Jewelry robberies open in Chapter 3, when the mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun. Pick a store, go to its locked back door and open it with the Snap Gun — kicking the door in trips the alarm and ruins the attempt. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without anyone seeing you. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target. If anyone spots you, reload the save rather than pushing on.
trophies.tip: The Snap Gun is the whole trick: silent entry, no alarm, no witnesses.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Bank vaults unlock through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is, near the end of Chapter 4. Tail an armored security van to a large bank and slip into the vault while the guard has it open. Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the bags alone. Each vault job puts you straight on a 4-star Wanted Level, so escaping with your partner also earns Hot Together. Rob 5 vaults and escape each time; the 100% checklist wants all 8, so keep going past the trophy.
trophies.tip: The trophy pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck, then escape the police. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida — tail one to a quiet stretch, block it or force it to stop, take the cash, and lose the Wanted Level. A vault job also puts you on a truck's tail, so this often pops while you are working on Maximum Withdrawal.
trophies.tip: Pick a truck far from police stations and have a fast getaway car parked nearby.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner in, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. The chain breaks if the Wanted Level fades — even dropping to the red heat zone alone ends it — so keep moving and hit the next shop fast. Pick three small shops close together, rob each quickly, and keep driving. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before hitting a fourth.
trophies.tip: Plan the route before the first robbery: three shops on one street beats three across town.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Illegal operations are marked on the map; each belongs to a gang, and the counter tracks which gangs you have hit. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations robbed, so this trophy pops naturally on the way to A Long Road — just make sure you spread the robberies across gangs instead of hitting the same gang's spots nine times.
trophies.tip: Check the counter after each robbery to see which gangs are still missing.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, reach a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose the police and escape the heat zone completely. The easiest way is a bank vault job: it hands you 4 stars immediately, and escaping it with your partner earns this trophy at the same time as progress toward Maximum Withdrawal. The trophy pops once you are clear of the red heat zone, not while you are still inside the flashing search area.
trophies.tip: Lose the cops in the countryside or the swamps, where sightlines are long and cover is easy.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 unique stunts across Leonida. Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife-edge flights and base jumps all count, and there are 397 stunts in the game, so you need a little over half of them. The 100% checklist needs 300, so do not stop at the trophy pop. Fold stunts into everything else you do: take a jump whenever one is on your route, and save dedicated stunt runs for the post-story cleanup.
trophies.tip: Fast bikes and stunt planes are the best tools; a stunt counts the moment the game registers it, so you do not need a clean landing every time.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across the two shooting ranges. Gold medals need speed and accuracy together: learn each challenge's target pattern first with a slow run, then push the pace. Use the weapon the challenge gives you rather than fighting it, reload during the lulls, and replay a challenge immediately while the pattern is fresh in your head.
trophies.tip: Headshots score far more than body shots; aim high and let the recoil settle between bursts.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. You only need one win per location, not every race at each spot. Learn the gates on a first attempt, then race clean: cut corners where the gates allow it, keep the drone low to hold speed, and brake early for tight turns instead of overshooting them.
trophies.tip: Replay a location right after a loss while you still remember where the tricky gates are.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different race events count, not repeat wins of the same one, so work through the race list: street races, off-road, boat and air races all feed the same counter. Pick races that suit the vehicle you are best with first, upgrade that vehicle, and save the awkward ones for last.
trophies.tip: The Yago street-racing strand counts too, so do it early — it is time-sensitive.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the activities that also feeds Master of None, so try it early. In a fishing challenge, watch the line tension and the fish's runs: reel steadily, ease off when the fish surges, and do not let the line snap. Cal is beatable on a first serious attempt once you get the rhythm of the reel.
trophies.tip: Do this in Chapter 1 alongside the balcony meditation — both are early-game tasks.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play any one of the four in-game arcade games through to completion. Any of the four counts, so pick the one you find easiest and finish a full game. Arcades are also an activity for Master of None, so this trophy usually pops while you are sampling everything.
trophies.tip: The easiest arcade game is the one you already know how to play — finish that one.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The counter tracks which types you have sampled, so check it after each new activity to see what is left. Fishing, arcade games, gym training, meditation, racing, shooting ranges, drone races, hunting and golf-style leisure activities are all on the list — one try each is enough, no scores or wins needed.
trophies.tip: Sample a new activity whenever one appears near you instead of making a special trip for all nine.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close. THE MISSABLE ONE: in Chapter 1, after Lucia is home — a morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time — she walks out to the balcony of Jason's house to meditate. Follow her and accept the optional task. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and it is not confirmed whether the trophy strictly needs that spot, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. For the other spots, bring your partner: each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters.
trophies.tip: MISSABLE — the only trophy in the game reported as missable. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation and keep a save from Chapter 1.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress, then Challenges, and most of them complete on their own while you play — driving, fighting, exploring and earning money all feed them. The 100% checklist needs 70 of the 80, so keep going past this trophy. In the cleanup phase, open the Challenges list and knock out the nearest ones: short driving and combat challenges first, then the longer grinds.
trophies.tip: Check the Challenges list before any long drive or fight — you will often be one small action from finishing one.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — in shops, in mission areas and in out-of-the-way spots — and each set needs every card in it. Collect as you travel rather than hunting all at once, and keep a running note of which sets are one or two cards short so the final sweep is short. The last cards of a set are the ones that take the time.
trophies.tip: Finish the sets whose cards cluster near places you already visit for other trophies.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to tag 100 different locations across Leonida. WAiNK is the in-game photo-tagging app: open it at a landmark, a vista or a point of interest and tag the spot. It pairs perfectly with exploration — tag every new place you drive through instead of making 100 special trips, and the counter climbs while you do everything else. The 100% checklist and The Goodtime State both push you to the same corners of the map.
trophies.tip: Scanning a vehicle with WAiNK also counts as discovering it for Whip It Good — tag cars as you drive.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive — point the app at cars, bikes, trucks and boats whenever they pass. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning long past this trophy. Rare vehicles cluster around wealthy districts, the port and the airport.
trophies.tip: Make scanning a habit at every red light: a few seconds per car adds up to dozens a session.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 regions on the PSN counter. The map fills in as you travel, so this is mostly a matter of driving everywhere: the cities, the swamps, the islands and the far corners. Pair it with WAiNK tagging and vehicle scanning so every mile earns progress on three trophies at once. The last few regions are the remote ones, so save a dedicated road trip for the end.
trophies.tip: Fly the map in a small plane to spot the blank patches, then drive into them.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge — planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. The jets at gates E3 and E4 work. Climb into the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first, because the police come fast.
trophies.tip: Do not take off from the taxiway — use the runway, and keep the climb gentle until you are clear.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a military tank — the Rhino. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until the trophy pops. Expect a heavy police response, so do not plan anything delicate for the minutes after.
trophies.tip: Drive the tank away from the base before you start firing, so you are not fighting soldiers and police at once.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; sell them on to your contacts to clean the money. The $250,000 total is cumulative, so it builds up across the whole game — bank vaults and loan jobs are the biggest sources. Keep laundering after every big job instead of letting the bills pile up.
trophies.tip: Vault jobs pay in Marked Bills, so this trophy and Maximum Withdrawal progress together.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative and counts every kind of shop — clothes, weapons, food, car parts, everything. It builds naturally as you gear up, and by the time you have bought the garages for Little Boxes you will be most of the way there. If you are short at the end, spend the remainder on ammo and car upgrades, which are never wasted.
trophies.tip: Do not hoard cash for this one — spending is the progress.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count — only the ones you buy. Buy them as soon as you can afford them: each one is storage for the cars you register for On the Spot.
trophies.tip: Buy garages before registering cars — each registration needs a free garage space.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap, common cars — ten of them, one after another.
trophies.tip: Register the cheapest cars you find; the trophy counts registrations, not the value of the cars.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim — press L3 and R3 while aiming. Find a group of enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and drop five of them before the Focus meter runs out. An assault rifle works best, and Adrenaline extends Focus if you need a few more seconds.
trophies.tip: Illegal operations give you grouped, armed enemies on demand — the perfect setup.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob Kingpin Bowling — the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, an illegal operation you first visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable — just return and finish the set.
trophies.tip: Grab the watch and the shotgun before you blow the safe, so the explosion does not rush you.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch — the description is the only official hint. The method reported by launch-week guides is that it pops when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength: buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you. Train regularly from early in the game and it should unlock as both characters max out. Treat this as reported, not proven, until it is checked in the game.
trophies.tip: Train with your partner along — the pair training is the point of the description.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Fill the Criminal Profile counter: 500 actions that change your profile. Robberies, fights and other criminal acts all feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind — just play the game like a criminal and check the counter now and then. By the time you have robbed the vaults, the operations and the shops, you will be most of the way there.
trophies.tip: This is a background counter. If it is short at the end, rob shops and fight gang members until it pops.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch — no verified unlock method yet, and the description is the only hint. The plain reading is: go to Ocean Beach, find a bar or a spot with a view over the water, and order a cocktail. Try the beachfront bars in Vice City and drink there while looking out to sea. It may pop during normal play; if it does not, try different beach bars and times of day.
trophies.tip: The description is the whole clue — a cocktail, a view, Ocean Beach.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch — no verified unlock method yet. The description points at a classic GTA move: drive a car out of a vehicle showroom through its front window. Find a car dealership showroom, get in a car inside, and smash out through the glass. It may pop during normal play; try it at a showroom you can enter with a vehicle.
trophies.tip: The name is a pun on the act — smashing out of the showroom is the whole idea.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch — no verified unlock method yet. The description, 'Second time's the charm,' suggests failing at something once and succeeding on the second try — a retry, a second attempt at a stunt, a race or a robbery. It may pop during normal play; there is no known specific trigger yet, so do not grind for it — let it come to you and check back as launch-week reports confirm it.
trophies.tip: If a stunt or race fails, retry it immediately — second attempts are the theme.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch — no verified unlock method yet. The description, 'What the hell just happened?', points at one of the game's strange, scripted moments — the kind of odd event Rockstar hides in the world. It may pop during normal play while exploring; there is no known specific trigger yet. Keep exploring odd corners of Leonida and check back as launch-week reports pin it down.
trophies.tip: Strange-trophy hunting rule: if something weird happens in the world, you are probably near it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch — no verified unlock method yet. The name and description point at a melee drive-by at or near a bowling alley: knocking people over with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle, bowling-pin style. Try it near Kingpin Bowling with a melee weapon equipped as a passenger or driver. The precise method is still being confirmed, so treat this as the best current reading, not a proven route.
trophies.tip: A melee drive-by needs a slow vehicle and a crowded spot — the bowling alley car park is the obvious place to try.
